title: Flightning99's Suzu Limited
description: A stripped down version of "Flightning99's Suzu" that can be used as a Server Resource Pack to add my pet cat Suzu
body:
A stripped down version of my "Flightning99's Suzu" Resource Pack that that changes the fewest neccesary textures to be used on a Server

Textures
- Cat Spawn Egg texture updated to match my pet cat Suzu
- Calico Cat and Kitten textures updated to match my pet cat Suzu
- Cloud texture updated to have the pattern vary in density over time
- Custom "Suzu" Painting
  - Requires "Flightning99's Crafting Tweaks" Data Pack
